title: Billing retry schedule
formatHelp: Enter up to 4 whole days from 1 to 28, separated by commas, in increasing order (for example, 3, 7). Leave blank for no automatic retries.
invalidRetryDays: Use up to 4 different whole days from 1 to 28 in increasing order, or leave blank.
scheduleHelp: Retries count from the invoice’s first failed payment and run at 09:00 in the gym’s timezone. Changes apply at the next first failure. Invoices already in dunning keep their original schedule and queued retries.
emailsHelp: Every failed attempt sends one dunning email when member emails are enabled, up to 5 emails with 4 retries. With no automatic retries, the first failure sends one email and the invoice stays past due.
emailCount: Maximum dunning emails from the first failure and automatic retries: {count}.
conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload the saved schedule and review your changes before saving again.
error: The request failed. Please try again.
